totals.note: Five failed controls represent two newly confirmed defects. Synthetic control totals are not unittest suite totals.

findings.mechanism: PurePosixPath.is_absolute misses Windows drive-prefixed spellings. C:/.../authorized/evidence.txt and C:evidence.txt are accepted on Windows with matching bytes inside root; both shapes also pass without root. This contradicts portable repository-relative POSIX artifact contract.
findings.minimal_patch: Reject Windows drive prefixes portably before filesystem resolution while preserving allowed in-root symlinks.
findings.acceptance: All four controls reject drive-prefixed paths; ordinary relative paths continue passing; outside containment remains enforced.

findings.mechanism: Python API supplied authoritative_criteria_ref is not passed through _tree/serialization; artifact_id with lone surrogate is accepted although it cannot encode as strict UTF-8. CLI read_json already rejects.
findings.minimal_patch: Validate supplied authoritative reference with _tree before artifact use, matching other supplied-context guards; or guard artifact string UTF-8 encodability.
findings.acceptance: Actual surrogate API input raises controlled ContractError; valid authoritative reference remains accepted.
findings.boundary: No Owner authentication or containment bypass demonstrated.

already_covered: Ordered exact Unicode, NFC/NFD distinction, confusables, whitespace, Markdown, punctuation, case, LF versus CRLF, omitted/added/duplicated/reordered criteria and mismatched criterion IDs are rejected without normalization.
Mandatory missing source and missing root fail closed; stale digest, renamed stale source and wrong artifact kind reject.
Duplicate JSON keys in both source and plan reject even when hashes are freshly updated. Strict UTF-8, surrogates, NaN, numeric overflow, oversized byte/string/container/depth inputs reject.

Unknown top-level/payload/nested command fields, boolean plan revision/exit code and invalid control characters reject. Ordinary requests without a mandatory sidecar continue validating at helper level; operational documentation drift was separately assigned.
Relative evidence path with matching digest passes; stale digest, traversal, POSIX absolute paths, backslashes and actual outside-root target reject.
unverified: Two Windows symlink controls skipped with WinError1314. They establish neither allowed-link behavior nor security containment. Root assigned Windows junction and WSL checks elsewhere.
No authentic separately Owner-approved criteria fixture established. Caller trust cannot be inferred from matching SHA256 or an agent-written reference.
No host identity/authentication, native activation, role configuration, race-free access or OS sandbox guarantees established.
This helper intentionally validates partial pre-dispatch contexts; valid prefixes/empty lists do not establish task termination. Caller must require final original Planner check.
